# Robotic Systems Lab | ETH Zurich

> > Leading research laboratory advancing legged robotics and planetary exploration through innovative robotic systems at ETH Zurich.

The Robotic Systems Lab (RSL) at ETH Zurich conducts cutting-edge research in legged robot locomotion and space robotics applications. The lab brings together faculty, doctoral researchers, and collaborators to push the boundaries of autonomous robotic systems for challenging environments.
